files.ASSURANCE.txt:
FEATHERED BUNDLE ASSURANCE LEGEND

What Feathered proved about the artifacts in this bundle, strongest first.
Counts are the number of packages recording that mode; one package can
record several, because provenance is multi-axis rather than a single tier.

Read 'DOES NOT PROVE' before relying on any row. A stronger-sounding name
does not mean a stronger guarantee; the rank below is the ordering.

[rank  30] Acquisition digest  (acquisition-digest)
    packages       : 3
    authority      : acquisition
    proves         : The acquisition repository's digest for this artifact was checked against the downloaded bytes.
    does not prove : Authenticity of that digest on its own. Read this axis together with whether an archive or vendor signature also applies.

[rank  30] Digest only  (digest-only)
    packages       : 3
    authority      : acquisition
    proves         : The digest published by the acquisition repository matched the bytes that were downloaded, so the transfer was not corrupted.
    does not prove : That the digest is authentic. Nothing signed the metadata, so a party able to alter the payload could alter the published digest with it.

Full per-package detail is in provenance.json.
